firstPlayerRule: Players take their turns simultaneously. Pick a Guide to manage the Temple cards and coordinate the phases; there is no individual first explorer.
clarifications: Players reveal their Explore or Exit cards together when the Guide gives the signal.
This file does not specify a personal criterion for choosing the Guide. The older ©2018 rules prefer someone familiar with the game; that preference is not stated here.
